Would Rather for What Is Preferable
You use would rather to express the preferences you have on a particular topic.

We can use would rather to show the preference that exists over one thing to another.

You need to take into account who the subject of the idea is. Depending on that, the construction of would rather changes.

If the object and the subject of the idea are the same, you use the following structure: Subject + would rather (‘d rather) + verb base form+ complement

Example:

You 'd rather take a look at the manual to avoid further errors.

When the object of the second clause is someone different from the first subject, the structure is as follows: subject + would rather (‘d rather) + different subject + verb in past + complement

Example:

We'd rather you transformed the app design as there are some mistakes.

Notice that, even though the verb in the sentence is in past, the meaning of the sentence is in present.
Firstly, I would rather identify and understand the main problem the company is dealing with.

The architecture design process is important to create or design software and apps.

Before creating any app or software, it is extremely important to make a design of such software or app. To do so, you might need to follow some steps that are included in the architecture design process.

images.text: Creating an app is no child's play as many people may think. In fact, in order to create an app or any specific software, you need to follow a schema. Why? Because during the last decade, building apps and software has been a complex story as you had to take into account many different aspects. For this reason, we would rather you used the steps listed below before creating your own app.

Firstly, if I were to create an app, I would rather identify and understand the main problem the company is dealing with before starting the design. Notice that this step is the most important as it focuses on what the company has developed or offered so far to its clients. Therefore, what the app seeks is to complement or help the company. Once you identified the problematic, you have established the limits and the context of the system, which correspond to the next step, you need to identify what design elements and relationships as well as parameters the software is going to need to enclose the company's needs. This is why you can attain this step by using a design structure matrix. Thirdly, I would rather evaluate the design in order to ensure that the architectural quality of the system is as per the required standards.

Finally, if the design is suitable, you can conclude the design process. On the contrary, if something has gone wrong, simply because you have forgotten something or because the design hasn't met the standards and requirements, I'd rather transform the design or do it all over again. Either way, you can transform the architecture design by applying different styles or patterns. Once you have accomplished this step, we would rather you performed a further evaluation to guarantee a perfect design.
